Cover: (a) some square has its centre in the box of BL(0,1) -- add that box as a second
conditioned square and re-solve at budget-1; (b) no square occupies BL(0,1) -- add the NO-family for BL(0,1), which deletes exactly the columns the LP is leaning on.

what it needs to be a certified leaf: (a) the two children emitted and LP-certified at s0; (b) the NO-family arm needs the occupancy transfer of Lemma B-NO to stay sound on the window; (c) the conditioned-pair gate (cores pairwise disjoint) checked for the first child.
